description: This Java interface defines a factory for creating MQTT clients and client builders, specifically for HiveMQ MQTT clients. It includes methods for creating new clients and builders with various configurations, such as connection parameters, reconnect options, and listeners for connection events. The interface is parametrized with generic types for different client implementations.

classes.name: HiveMqttClientFactory
classes.description: A factory interface for creating MQTT clients and client builders with configurable options and event listeners.

methods.name: newClient
methods.description: Creates a new MQTT client instance using provided connection info, identifier, reconnect setting, event listeners, and a connection logger.

methods.name: newClientBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new MQTT client builder configured with connection info, identifier, reconnect setting, event listeners, and connection logger.

methods.name: default newClient
methods.description: Default method that invokes 'newClient' with null listeners for connection and disconnection events.
